summary: This video showcases a high-performing Thunderbolt team against the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque (Phase 2), achieving over 1.11 billion total damage. Perkunte serves as the primary damage carry, generating over 804 million damage alone. The full setup features Alaura, Tariz, Shai'nachtan, and Maashtur providing support, lightning synergies, and sustain. Detailed equipment, character stats, and skill timings are displayed at the end of the run.

heroes.name: Perkunte
heroes.note: Acted as the hyper-carry against Mekkatorque, dealing 804.8M damage (72.8% of the team's total damage).

heroes.name: Alaura
heroes.note: Provided Lightning Chain enhancements and contributed 25.3M damage.

heroes.name: Tariz
heroes.note: Helped stack Electricity and trigger Lightning Chain procs, doing 27.7M damage.

heroes.name: Shai'nachtan
heroes.note: Granted team buffs, served as a Lightning Chain target, and contributed 22.8M damage with a tuned 15.0s recast on his Ultimate.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Absorbed team damage and provided defensive shields to keep the team alive through Mekkatorque's phases.

teams.note: Full Thunderbolt endgame team dealing 1,110,648,493 total damage. Shai'nachtan uses a 15.0s recast timing on his ultimate while all other heroes run default skill timings.

tips: Tune Shai'nachtan's ultimate recast timing to 15.0s to optimize buff and chain alignment against Mekkatorque.
Perkunte requires heavy offensive investment as he accounts for the vast majority of Thunderbolt team damage in single-target boss fights.
